cases.title: A move meant to be constant speed is eased: one sentence on which end isn't linear; checked again

rubric.reason: After all pairs were held, Turn 3 asks "Is there a move here that should run at constant speed", and when the check returned not_linear, Turn 4 names the end ("In its move from 0.25 s to 4.25 s, the key at 0.25 s eases out"), says how to set Linear, and ends "say done" to check again without fixing it or calling it linear.

Turn 4 says what is off and where with real names and times ("Blink's keys at 1 s, 1.4 s and 1.8 s need their holds back"; "the key at 0.25 s eases out") and ends "Fix both and say done" with no fix or offer, and its Linear how-to is what R-KT-LINEAR-CHECK requires, so it doesn't count as spelling out the fix.

Blink, Cut, Seal, Dot 1 at 0.5 s, Spinner's Rotation 0.25–4.25 s with the start side, and the times 1.2 s, 1.6 s and 2 s (the check's frame_time values) all match tool results, and "half see-through" follows from the eased 100-to-0 pair.

Once all three pairs were held, the mentor asked "Is there a move here that should run at constant speed, like a steady spin?"; when the check returned not_linear, it did not call the move linear, said "the key at 0.25 s, at the start of the 0.25 s to 4.25 s move, isn't linear", gave the Linear how-to, asked for "done" to check again, and made no change itself.

In Turn 4 the mentor names what is off and where (Blink's pairs at 1 s, 1.4 s and 1.8 s, and Spinner's key at 0.25 s), and leaves the work with "Hold Blink's three pairs again, make Spinner's key at 0.25 s linear, and say done"; it makes no offer to fix, and the Linear how-to is what R-KT-LINEAR-CHECK requires.

Blink, Cut, Seal, Dot 1 and Spinner, Opacity, Position and Rotation, and the times 0.5 s, 1 s, 1.2 s, 1.4 s, 1.8 s, 3 s, 0.25 s and 4.25 s all match tool results, and "partway see-through" at 1.2 s follows from the eased state and values of the 1 s to 1.4 s pair.

Once all pairs were held, the mentor asked "Is there a move here that should run at constant speed"; after the check returned not_linear, it said "the key at 0.25 s still eases out", explained how to set Linear, fixed nothing, and ended "then say done".

In turn 4 the mentor names what is off and where ("All three pairs, from 1 s to 2.2 s, fade again"; "the key at 0.25 s still eases out") and neither changes nor offers to change anything; its Linear how-to is the instruction R-KT-LINEAR-CHECK requires, and it ends "Get Blink snapping again and Spinner linear, then say done."

Blink, Cut, Seal, Dot 1, Spinner, Opacity, Rotation and all cited times (including 1–2.2 s and 0.25–4.25 s) match tool results, and "half see-through" at 1.2 s follows from the eased 100-to-0 pair from 1 s to 1.4 s.
